DB_BACKEND.description: Database backend type. Use 'supabase' to use Supabase cloud, otherwise defaults to local Docker

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string for local Docker setup (e.g., postgresql+asyncpg://rw_user:rw_pass@localhost:5432/readwise)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key for generating embeddings

READWISE_TOKEN.description: Your Readwise API token. Get it from https://readwise.io/api_token

SUPABASE_DB_URL.description: Full PostgreSQL connection string from Supabase dashboard (required when DB_BACKEND=supabase)

servers.name: Readwise Vector DB MCP Server

servers.description: Read-only MCP server for YNAB that provides tools for budgets, accounts, categories, transactions, and financial summaries via HTTP or stdio.

YNAB_PLAN_ID.description: Default plan ID for tools that accept planId

MCP_AUTH_MODE.description: Legacy compatibility shim: none or oauth

MCP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public MCP URL, required in OAuth modes

MCP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE.description: Deployment mode: authless, oauth-single-tenant, or oauth-hardened

MCP_AUTH2_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path to auth2 JSON config file

MCP_OAUTH_SKIP_LOCAL_CONSENT.description: Set to true to skip local consent screen

servers.name: ynab-mcp-bridge
